result.title: SMILE: A Structured Multi-Agent Clinical Reasoning for Liver Ultrasound Understanding
result.comment: Accepted at Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV) 2027
result.summary: Automated liver ultrasound report generation improves the diagnosis of liver diseases by producing clinically structured descriptions of anatomical and disease-related findings. However, current generative vision-language models (VLMs) often rely on a single reasoning pathway that maps ultrasound appearance directly to textual descriptions. In addition to the inherent vision-language modality gap, this design is limited for liver ultrasound because disease interpretation is constrained by subtle visual evidence, heterogeneous disease patterns, and limited paired supervision. To address these limitations, we propose SMILE, a Structured Multi-agent clInicaL rEasoning framework that uses multiple complementary specialist agents to interpret ultrasound images and consolidates their outputs through a judge-guided consensus mechanism. Our approach employs three specialized agents: an image interpretation agent for morphological descriptions, a clinical-stage reasoning agent, and a visual question answering (VQA) agent for targeted queries. These agent responses are then aggregated and scrutinized by a judge VLM using a consensus filtering prompt to produce a unified, clinically coherent output. Across a public liver ultrasound dataset and an internal clinical dataset, SMILE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art VLMs, achieving up to 19.0\% improvement in ROUGE-1 and 18.8\% improvement in clinical F1-score, while reaching VQA F1-scores of 0.82 and 0.65 on public and internal datasets, respectively. These results demonstrate the potential of SMILE for data-scarce and limited-supervision clinical settings. Our models, datasets, and code are available \href{https://github.com/CMME-Lab/SMILE}{here}.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SMILE 框架，用图像解读、临床分期推理与 VQA 三个专科智能体解读肝脏超声图像，再由 judge VLM 以共识过滤提示汇总为结构化报告，在公开与内部数据集上提升 ROUGE 与临床 F1。
AI.relevance_reason: 属医疗超声报告生成的任务型应用，其多智能体输出汇总只是文本层面的提示集成与指标提升，未涉及内部状态、证据获取、停止决策或贡献分配等机制分析，与 LVR 主线缺乏实质联系。
